info.title: linkedin (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: LinkedIn API v2. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {token}. Resources are identified by URNs (e.g. urn:li:person:{id}, urn:li:organization:{id}).

get.summary: Retrieve the currently authenticated member's profile. Returns profile data including name, headline, location, industry
get.description: Retrieve the currently authenticated member's profile. Returns profile data including name, headline, location, industry, and contact details.

200.description: {success, id, localizedFirstName, localizedLastName, headline, location, summary, public_profile_url, profile_picture_url, phone}

get.summary: Fetch a LinkedIn member's profile by their ID. Returns complete profile information for the specified person.
get.description: Fetch a LinkedIn member's profile by their ID. Returns complete profile information for the specified person.

get.summary: Query LinkedIn profiles using keywords, company, job title, or location. Returns matching profiles from the user's conne
get.description: Query LinkedIn profiles using keywords, company, job title, or location. Returns matching profiles from the user's connections and wider network.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Search terms matched against name, headline, summary, or email.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Narrow results to profiles at this company.

get.summary: Retrieve the authenticated member's first-degree connections. Optionally filter by keywords matching name, headline, or
get.description: Retrieve the authenticated member's first-degree connections. Optionally filter by keywords matching name, headline, or company.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Query type â€” use 'viewer' to fetch the authenticated member's connections.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Restrict connections by name, headline, or company.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Connections to return per page (default 50, recommended max 50).

get.summary: Enumerate LinkedIn organizations and companies. Filter by name or restrict to organizations the current user manages.
get.description: Enumerate LinkedIn organizations and companies. Filter by name or restrict to organizations the current user manages.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filter organizations by partial name match.

parameters.name: role_type
parameters.description: Restrict results by the user's role type.

get.summary: Retrieve detailed information for a specific LinkedIn organization or company by ID.
get.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific LinkedIn organization or company by ID.

get.summary: Fetch information for a LinkedIn job posting by its ID. Returns the job title, company, location, description, and requi
get.description: Fetch information for a LinkedIn job posting by its ID. Returns the job title, company, location, description, and requirements.

200.description: {success, id, title, company_id, company_name, location, is_active, description, workplace_type, employment_type, seniority_level, industry, job_functions, skills_required, experience_years, salary_range, apply_url, posted_at, expires_at}

post.summary: Publish a UGC post or article on behalf of the authenticated user. Accepts both the standard LinkedIn UGC nested format
post.description: Publish a UGC post or article on behalf of the authenticated user. Accepts both the standard LinkedIn UGC nested format and a simplified flat parameter format.

requestBody.description: Body: Standard LinkedIn format: {author (required, string â€” URN e.g. urn:li:person:{id} or urn:li:organization:{id}), lifecycleState (required, string â€” must be 'PUBLISHED'), specificContent: {'com.linkedin.ugc.ShareContent': {shareCommentary: {text (required, string â€” post text, max 3000 chars)}, shareMediaCategory (required, string â€” 'NONE'|'ARTICLE'|'IMAGE'|'VIDEO'|'RICH'|'CAROUSEL'|'NATIVE_DOCUMENT'|'LIVE_VIDEO')}}, visibility: {'com.linkedin.ugc.MemberNetworkVisibility': 'PUBLIC'|'CONNECTIONS'|'LOGGED_IN'}}. Simplified format: {comment (string â€” post text), visibility__code ('PUBLIC' or 'CONNECTIONS'), content__title, content__description, content__submitted_url, content__submitted_image_url}

get.summary: Locate UGC posts by author. The official API accepts q=authors with an authors=List(URN) parameter. This endpoint additi
get.description: Locate UGC posts by author. The official API accepts q=authors with an authors=List(URN) parameter. This endpoint additionally supports filtering by author profile ID or matching against post text.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Query mode â€” use 'authors' to retrieve posts from a specific author.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Restrict posts to this author's profile ID.

post.summary: Publish an update or post to a company page. The authenticated user must hold administrator privileges for the specified
post.description: Publish an update or post to a company page. The authenticated user must hold administrator privileges for the specified company.

requestBody.description: Body: {company or company_id (required, string â€” company ID), comment (required, string â€” update text), submitted_url (optional, string â€” link URL), image_url (optional, string â€” image URL), title (optional, string â€” content title), description (optional, string â€” content description)}

post.summary: Dispatch a connection invitation to another LinkedIn member. Identify the recipient by profile URL, profile ID, or invit
post.description: Dispatch a connection invitation to another LinkedIn member. Identify the recipient by profile URL, profile ID, or invitee identifier. Sending duplicate invitations to the same profile will be rejected.

200.description: {success, id, invitation_id, profile_url, status ('sent'), sent_at, message, invitation_type, sender_profile_id, recipient_profile_url}

requestBody.description: Body: {profile_url or invitee_url or invitee (required, string â€” target LinkedIn profile URL or profile ID), message (optional, string â€” custom invitation note), tracking_token (optional, string)}

post.summary: Deliver a direct message to a LinkedIn connection. Identify the recipient by profile ID, email, profile URL, or a recipi
post.description: Deliver a direct message to a LinkedIn connection. Identify the recipient by profile ID, email, profile URL, or a recipients array.

requestBody.description: Body: {text or body (required, string â€” message text), profile_id (string â€” recipient profile ID), email (string â€” recipient email address), profile_url (string â€” recipient profile URL), recipients (array of person URN strings e.g. ['urn:li:person:{id}']), subject (optional, string â€” conversation title)}. Provide at least one of profile_id, email, profile_url, or recipients to identify the recipient.

id.description: Unique identifier for the member's profile.

localizedFirstName.description: Given name in the member's locale.

localizedLastName.description: Family name in the member's locale.

summary.description: The About/bio section of the member's profile.

to.description: URN identifying the connected member (e.g. urn:li:person:xxx).

Company.description: A LinkedIn company or organization page.

admin_ids.description: Profile IDs of users who administer the page.

Post.description: A LinkedIn post such as a UGC share or company update.

author.description: URN of the post author (e.g. urn:li:person:{id} or urn:li:organization:{id}).

text.description: The body text of the post.

Invitation.description: A LinkedIn connection request sent to another member.

Message.description: A private direct message on LinkedIn.
